title: New session starts fresh, and sessions are never labelled spin-offs

requirements.text: New session in a project with no open session starts a new conversation, not the last one
requirements.check: manual: driver newSession on a project whose session was ended -> different conversation id

requirements.text: Reopen from Recently ended still resumes the ended conversation
requirements.check: manual: driver reopen -> conversation id equals the ended one

requirements.text: No visible spin-off label or branch icon on sessions
